home.title: Share LLM-generated docs
home.subtitle: Paste HTML or Markdown, or drag & drop a file, and get a shareable URL instantly. No signup needed.

deploy.title: 3-Second Deploy
deploy.description: Just paste and click. No signup, no config, no build step — get a URL instantly.

preview.title: Live Preview
preview.description: See your changes in real time. Supports both HTML and Markdown.

url.title: Clean URLs
url.description: Get short, shareable URLs like drafturl.com/xK9mP2nQ.

ai.title: AI Editing (Coming Soon)
ai.description: Soon you'll be able to ask AI to refine your document — like "make the table cleaner."

paste.title: Paste or Drag & Drop
paste.description: Paste HTML or Markdown from ChatGPT, Claude, or any LLM into the editor — or drag & drop an .html/.md file.

check.title: Check the Preview
check.description: See the result in the live preview on the right. Edit on the spot if needed.

share.title: Get a Share URL
share.description: One click on Share and you're done. Send the URL to anyone.
